plain_english: Pull everything known about this person: the form they filled, the CRM record, any earlier leads, and whether they already bought from us.
inputs: Raw lead record, CRM history, student master
if_it_fails: The evaluation stops and the lead is flagged. Never evaluate on a partial load.

step_name: Check we are allowed to contact them
plain_english: Before anything else, check consent, opt outs, bad numbers and whether they already bought.
pseudocode: if suppression_check(lead) is blocked:\n    log('suppressed', reason)\n    return NO_ACTION
if_it_fails: Nothing is sent. This is the correct outcome, not a failure.

plain_english: Standardise the phone number, lowercase the email, match the city to the city master, map the source to one of the 45 known values.
if_it_fails: Unmapped values are logged. A rising unmapped rate means the taxonomy has drifted.

plain_english: Where two sources say different things about the same fact, mark the field as disputed rather than picking one.
pseudocode: for f in DECISION_CRITICAL:\n    if sources_disagree(lead, f):\n        lead.field_conflict_flags.add(f)
if_it_fails: The disputed field is not used in any message and a verification task is raised.

plain_english: Use the precedence order: what they said themselves beats what a counsellor recorded, which beats a form, which beats a guess.
pseudocode: for f in lead.field_conflict_flags:\n    lead[f] = highest_precedence(lead.sources[f])\n    if still_tied: keep_flagged(f)
if_it_fails: Anything still tied stays flagged and stays out of the message.

plain_english: Turn the tidy fields into the nine things we actually reason about: life stage, course interest, eligibility, capacity, relationship, source, engagement, urgency, location.
pseudocode: for d in DIMENSIONS:\n    lead.dim[d] = evaluate(d, lead)\n    lead.dim[d].confidence = confidence_of(d, lead)
outputs: Nine dimension values, each with a confidence
if_it_fails: A dimension that cannot be computed is set to Unknown, never guessed.

plain_english: Some dimensions depend on others. Eligibility needs the qualification. Suitability needs the life stage and the course.
pseudocode: lead.dim.eligibility = check_eligibility(lead.dim.course, lead.dim.life_stage, lead.qualification)\nlead.dim.suitability = check_suitability(lead.dim.course, lead.dim.life_stage)
if_it_fails: Unknown inputs produce Unknown outputs, which block payment links rather than guessing.

plain_english: Run every active guardrail. Blocking ones stop the process. Conflicts and warnings are recorded and shown.
if_it_fails: The user is told which rule fired and why, in plain English. Nothing is ever silently rejected.

plain_english: How well does this course suit this person. Life stage, eligibility, suitability, capacity and relationship. This score never decays with time.
pseudocode: lead.fit_score = sum(component(c, lead) for c in FIT_COMPONENTS)\nlead.fit_confidence = confidence_from_completeness(lead)
if_it_fails: Unknown inputs score neutral, never zero. A missing answer is not a bad answer.

plain_english: How close are they to acting. Source, engagement, stated urgency and what they have asked for. This score decays after 7 days of silence.
pseudocode: lead.intent_score = sum(component(c, lead) for c in INTENT_COMPONENTS)\nlead.intent_score -= decay(lead.days_since_last_engagement)\nlead.intent_confidence = confidence_from_evidence(lead)
if_it_fails: A lead with no engagement data starts at their source baseline, not at zero.

step_name: Turn the two scores into a priority
plain_english: Fit and intent together decide what a human should do today.
if_it_fails: Ineligible always becomes Redirect regardless of how keen they are.

plain_english: Test the lead against every cohort definition and keep the ones that match.
pseudocode: candidates = [c for c in COHORTS if c.matches(lead.dim)]
if_it_fails: If nothing matches, discovery is used and the miss is logged for review.

step_name: Throw out the combinations that make no sense
plain_english: Remove any candidate that a guardrail says is contradictory, impossible or commercially pointless.
pseudocode: candidates = [c for c in candidates if not violates_guardrail(c, lead)]
if_it_fails: If everything is removed, discovery is used and the reason is recorded.

step_name: Rank what is left and pick one
plain_english: The most specific match wins. A tie is logged, because a tie usually means a rule is missing.
if_it_fails: Ties are broken by the lower rule ID and reported weekly.

plain_english: The cohort selects the playbook, which is the actual sequence of messages, resources and calls.
Set the journey stage from what has actually happened, not from what anyone hopes.
if_it_fails: Everyone starts at New. A stage is never set by opinion.

step_name: Decide the single next thing to do
plain_english: Combine the cohort, the stage and the priority into one clear instruction and a date.
pseudocode: lead.next_action, lead.next_action_at = next_action(\n    lead.primary_cohort, lead.journey_stage, lead.priority)
if_it_fails: If no action can be determined the lead is parked with a reason, never left blank.

plain_english: Record in plain English which rules fired and what produced the cohort, the scores and the action.
if_it_fails: An evaluation without an explanation is treated as a bug, not a result.
